message: さっちんのラブラブ大作戦３

name: Sacchin
message: 「How did the Ahhn Project go? Did Synn-kun say 'ahhn' and feed you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like I could do something like that in broad daylight in front of people!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, shyness is the enemy of love~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if you say that...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So it's fine as long as nobody's watching, right~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, that's not the issue--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If you can't do anything even when nobody's watching, you really won't be able to do anything at all~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I want something more maidenly and romantic...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even a maiden turns into a grandma when she gets old~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A maidenly romance between a grandma and a grandpa doesn't sound half bad either!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hopefully Synn-kun stays single until then~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So it's fine as long as nobody's watching and it's not daytime, right~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I guess... that's how it works?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Then~ if you're all alone together in a dark place, you can do anything, right~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uh, well, that's...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You can at least pretend you have a stomachache, right~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If it's just that much...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Get Synn-kun to rub it for you~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Have Synn rub my stomach?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And then, tell him it's not just your stomach--your chest hurts too~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-If I say something like that, he'll end up groping my b-boobs!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's totally okay~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat?! S-So bold!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're gonna do it, you totally have to!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「M-My chest...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You got this~」
